verdict.rationale: Gitleaks documents event-triggered automation: a pre-commit hook, and Gitleaks-Action scans on pull requests and commits. It also offers on-demand scans. None of the evidence shows a product-native way to schedule recurring jobs; any cron-style scheduling would come from the host CI platform, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
